# PoEDB data

`divination-cards.json` is derived from https://poedb.tw/us/Divination_Cards by
`scripts/extract-poedb-cards.mjs`: card name, stack size and reward. Fetched 2026-11-23.

PoEDB content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/),
and that licence — attribution, non-commercial use, share-alike — applies to this file.

To refresh: save the page and run `node scripts/extract-poedb-cards.mjs <saved html file>`.
